note: Curated, source-cited allowlist of high-frequency single- and two-character Mandarin verb stems, compiled to close the predicate-tagging gap named in data/research-obligations.json (id: predicate-tagging). Each entry's stem, pinyin, and gloss are drawn from the drkameleon/complete-hsk-vocabulary dataset (github.com/drkameleon/complete-hsk-vocabulary, MIT license), filtered to entries carrying that dataset's own "v" (verb) part-of-speech tag for HSK 2.0 levels 1-3 (old-1/old-2/old-3), restricted to stems of 1-2 characters, and excluding any stem already curated elsewhere in this bundle (bundle.mjs's PARTICLES/DEMONSTRATIVES/PRONOUNS/CONJUNCTIONS/AUXILIARIES/COPULA/PREPOSITIONS/CLASSIFIER_CHARS). Per the dataset's own README, its part-of-speech tags (including "v") are sourced from SUBTLEX-CH (crr.ugent.be/programs-data/subtitle-frequencies/subtlex-ch) and HanLP (github.com/hankcs/HanLP) part-of-speech analysis, not from CC-CEDICT; CC-CEDICT (mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary) is the source for each entry's dictionary definition (gloss) and pinyin only, and HSK 2.0 level membership traces to github.com/clem109/hsk-vocabulary. Reviewed by hand after automated extraction: 15 entries were dropped for carrying only an archaic/literary verb sense that would misrepresent the character's actual dominant modern usage, or for colliding (same character, no tone marks in plain text) with a far more common grammatical-particle or high-frequency-adverb reading of the same character that this bundle cannot disambiguate (dropped: 没 号 便宜 白 错 难 树 作业 别 得 游戏 意思 题 就 还); one entry (教) had its automatically-picked reading overridden from the rarer literary causative sense to the common "jiao1" (to teach) reading. This is still a curated allowlist, not exhaustive morphosyntactic verb detection or a full verb lexicon -- see data/research-obligations.json and data/maturity.json for the honest grade.
